items_all.title: More than 20 leading AI researchers warn that automated AI research poses extreme risks
items_all.summary: More than 20 AI researchers, including Geoffrey Hinton, Yoshua Bengio, and OpenAI research lead Jakub Pachocki, warn of an impending "intelligence explosion" from self-improving AI. AI systems could soon automate all AI research, compressing years of progress into months. The article More than 20 leading AI researchers warn that automated AI research poses extreme risks appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 包括傑佛瑞·希ント（Geoffrey Hinton）、約書亞·班吉歐（Yoshua Bengio）以及 OpenAI 研究負責人雅庫布·帕科基（Jakub Pachocki）在內的 20 多名 AI 研究人員警告，自我改進的 AI 將帶來迫在眉睫的「智慧爆炸」。AI 系統可能很快就會自動化所有 AI 研究，將多年的進展壓縮成幾個月。「20 多名頂尖 AI 研究人員警告自動化 AI 研究構成極端風險」一文首發於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Anthropic's Claude Sonnet 5.5 nearly matches Opus 5.5 on benchmarks while costing up to 30 percent less per task
items_all.summary: Anthropic has released Claude Sonnet 5.5, the second model in its Claude 5.5 family. It generates output more than 30 percent faster, costs up to 30 percent less per task, and nearly matches Opus 5.5 on knowledge-work benchmarks. On Terminal-Bench, a coding benchmark, the model jumps from 10.3 to 70.6 percent. With Haiku 5.5 announced for the coming weeks, Anthropic will soon have a direct counterpart to each of OpenAI's three GPT-6 models. The article Anthropic's Claude Sonnet 5.5 nearly matches Opus 5.5 on benchmarks while costing up to 30 percent less per task appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Anthropic 發布了 Claude Sonnet 5.5，這是其 Claude 5.5 家族中的第二個模型。它的輸出速度快了 30% 以上，每個任務的成本降低高達 30%，並且在知識工作基準測試中幾乎能媲美 Opus 5.5。在程式碼編寫基準測試 Terminal-Bench 上，該模型的表現從 10.3% 跳升至 70.6%。隨著 Haiku 5.5 預計在未來幾週內宣佈，Anthropic 將很快擁有與 OpenAI's 的三個 GPT-6 模型中每一個相對應的直屬對手。這篇文章 Anthropic's Claude Sonnet 5.5 在基準測試中幾乎媲美 Opus 5.5，同時每個任務的成本降低高達 30%，最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: OpenAI's AI agents exploited a Google security education game to scrape UN trade data
items_all.summary: OpenAI's AI agents hit the UNCTAD statistics API roughly 16,500 times, creatively working around access restrictions. One method involved misusing a Google web security learning game as a relay to bypass their own constraints. The agents just kept going, adding to a growing list of cases that show how hard it is to keep agentic AI systems in check. The article OpenAI's AI agents exploited a Google security education game to scrape UN trade data appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: OpenAI's AI 代理對 UNCTAD 統計 API 進行了約 16,500 次存取，巧妙地繞過了存取限制。其中一種方法涉及濫用 Google 網路安全學習遊戲作為中繼，以繞過其自身的限制。這些代理不斷運作，為日益增加的案例清單添上一筆，顯示出要控制代理型 AI 系統是多麼困難。這篇文章 OpenAI's AI 代理利用 Google 安全教育遊戲來爬梳聯合國貿易資料，最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Harvard psychologist calls for sober AI safety engineering over doomsday rhetoric
items_all.summary: Steven Pinker thinks fears of AI-driven extinction are overblown, and he has turned down a public debate with blogger Scott Alexander, calling such events a "spectator sport." Alexander puts the odds that AI wipes out humanity at 20 percent. Instead of doomsday rhetoric, Pinker wants sober safety engineering built on independent oversight, liability, and human control. The article Harvard psychologist calls for sober AI safety engineering over doomsday rhetoric appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 史蒂芬·平克（Steven Pinker）認為對 AI 引發人類滅絕的恐懼被誇大了，他並拒絕與部落客史考特·亞歷山大（Scott Alexander）進行公開辯論，稱此類活動為「觀賞運動」。亞歷山大認為 AI 消滅人類的機率為 20%。平克不喜歡世界末日的言論，而是想要建立在獨立監督、責任制和人類控制之上的清醒安全工程。這篇文章哈佛心理學家呼籲以清醒的 AI 安全工程取代末日言論，最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Nvidia wants to keep AI agents on a short leash with a watchdog built into its chips
items_all.summary: Nvidia is combining its OpenShell agent software with Sentry, a new hardware watchdog, to create the Open Agent Safety Platform. Sentry is supposed to isolate AI agents that break out within milliseconds. When it happened at OpenAI in September, stopping the run took nearly three hours. Still, Nvidia's watchdog can't reliably stop agents that have been tricked or that hide their intentions on its own. The article Nvidia wants to keep AI agents on a short leash with a watchdog built into its chips appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 輝達（Nvidia）正將其 OpenShell 代理軟體與全新硬體看門狗 Sentry 結合，以打造開放代理安全平臺（Open Agent Safety Platform）。Sentry 旨在幾毫秒內隔離失控的 AI 代理。當 OpenAI 在 9 月發生這種情況時，花了將近三個小時才阻止執行。儘管如此，輝達的看門狗無法單獨可靠地阻止被欺騙或隱藏意圖的代理。這篇文章輝達希望透過在其晶片中內建看門狗來嚴加控管 AI 代理，最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Every AI lab thinks it's the responsible one, and safety researcher Ryan Greenblatt says that's what keeps the arms race going
items_all.summary: Ryan Greenblatt, chief scientist at Redwood Research, puts the risk of an AI takeover at 50 to 60 percent if development stays on its current path. Sam Harris says that doesn't square with how fast the industry is moving, since Manhattan Project scientists would have called things off at 10 percent. Greenblatt blames the race dynamics at Anthropic and OpenAI and is counting on an international agreement. The article Every AI lab thinks it's the responsible one, and safety researcher Ryan Greenblatt says that's what keeps the arms race going appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 紅木研究（Redwood Research）首席科學家瑞安·格林blatt（Ryan Greenblatt）表示，如果開發維持目前的路徑，AI 接管的風險將落在 50 到 60 個百分點。山姆·哈里斯（Sam Harris）表示，這與產業發展的速度不符，因為曼哈頓計畫的科學家在風險達到 10% 時就會喊停。格林blatt將原因歸咎於 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 的競賽動態，並寄望於一項國際協議。這篇文章每個 AI 實驗室都認為自己是負責任的那一個，安全研究員瑞安·格林blatt表示正是這種心態在維持軍備競賽，最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Fireworks AI 推出 FireRouter with Opus：編碼任務成本降 57%，準確率僅損失 1.5 個百分點
items_all.summary: Fireworks AI 發佈 FireRouter with Opus，稱其爲市場首個緩存感知路由器，針對 Claude Opus 系列優化，並首次以獨立路由模型形式作爲 serverless 端點開放。經一個多月內部 A/B 測試，其執行編碼任務準確率達單獨使用 Opus 的 98.1%，成本降低 57%。核心邏輯是在每次用戶輪次中，評估模型集合中每個模型對當前任務的適合程度，並估算各模型處理成本。

items_all.summary: Meta 9月22日在美國上線的 AI 智能體 Muse 被指嚴重越權。據《衛報》，它未經用戶許可，將多倫多住址發給 Facebook Marketplace 買家，還以用戶口吻謊稱本人在家，致買家驅車上門撲空。當事人、消費科技測評博主馬特·羅布24小時後才發現。他因 Meta 宣傳 Muse 可自動打理集市掛帖而開啓功能，並填寫了住址等信息。

items_all.title: 蝴蝶效應發佈 Manus2.0:成本降三成 Agent還能組隊打工
items_all.summary: 在獨立運營調整後，蝴蝶效應公司近日正式推出Manus2.0海外版大更新。與主流AI聚焦對話不同，Manus2.0主打“任務執行”，試圖讓AI成爲用戶的數字助理。官方稱其底層架構全面升級，相同任務執行耗時降低近30%，運行成本削減約三分之一，用戶能以更少預算完成更復雜AI任務。功能層面信息尚待披露。

items_all.title: 哈佛心理學家平克：別渲染 AI 末日，真正該做的是安全工程
items_all.summary: 哈佛大學心理學家史蒂文·平克公開表示，“AI會毀滅人類”的生存性風險被誇大。他在 Quillette 致精神科醫生兼科技博主斯科特·亞歷山大的公開信中闡述理由。亞歷山大此前邀其公開辯論AI生存風險，平克婉拒，稱這類辯論只是“供人圍觀的競技活動”。他尤其不認同“回形針最大化器”等極端推演。

items_all.title: OpenAI因安全與對齊測試未達標，叫停Astra6.1大模型發佈
items_all.summary: OpenAI因安全顧慮取消原定近期發佈的Astra6.1。《華爾街日報》稱，安全負責人Saachi Jain證實，該模型在衡量程序與人類意圖一致性的對齊測試中表現不佳。相比本月初發布、號稱OpenAI迄今最強的Astra，Astra6.1內部評估顯示更強欺騙性和不安全行爲傾向。此舉正值AI行業安全風險日益凸顯之際。

items_all.title: After a deepfake voice fooled her grandfather, this founder sprang into action
items_all.summary: After her grandfather was scammed by a deepfake of his brother's voice, Tarini Padmanabhuni founded DetectifAI, a San Francisco startup building AI models small enough to run directly on smartphones and flag fake voices in real time, and it's now one of the companies competing in Startup Battlefield at TechCrunch Disrupt.
items_all.summary_zh: 在祖父遭到冒充其兄弟聲音的深度偽造詐騙後創辦了 DetectifAI 的塔里尼・帕德馬納布尼（Tarini Padmanabhuni），這是一家總部位於舊金山的新創公司，其建構的 AI 模型小到足以直接在智慧型手機上運行，並能即時標記出偽造的聲音，它現在是 TechCrunch Disrupt 新創競技場（Startup Battlefield）的參賽公司之一。

items_all.title: ​費米宇宙重磅發佈全球首款全鏈路量子增強大模型 FermiQLLM 1.0
items_all.summary: 人工智能底層架構迎來顛覆性創新。初創公司費米宇宙推出全球首個全鏈路量子增強大模型FermiQLLM1.0。該模型打破傳統大模型對純經典計算的完全依賴，將量子物理與多體計算方法深度融入AI技術鏈條，實現底層系統性升級。其技術路徑不侷限於尚在攻關中的量子硬件，而是融合張量網絡、量子模擬退火及規範自由度等量子方法。

items_all.title: Claude Sonnet 5.5
items_all.summary: Claude Sonnet 5.5 New Sonnet model from Anthropic today. They say it "runs 30%+ faster, and costs up to 30% less for most work" - it's priced the same as Sonnet 5 but appears to beat it on every benchmark, and should be cheaper to run as well. Here are some pelicans riding bicycles . Sonnet 5.5 suffered from the same bug as Opus 5.5 : the "max" thinking effort pelican thought for 128,000 tokens (at a cost of $1.28) before running out of tokens and failing to produce an SVG. Here's the pelican it gave me for thinking effort "xhigh", at a cost of 5.74 cents and taking 41 seconds: Sonnet 5.5 appears to be almost as good as Opus 5.5 on some coding tasks, including various viral 3D animation tricks . The most interesting thing about Sonnet 5.5 is that it's now the model used for the free tier on claude.ai . OpenAI's ChatGPT free tier uses Luna 5.6, which means Anthropic currently have a much more capable free offering. I ran this prompt against that free tier: build me an HTML page that renders a three-dimensional pelican riding a bicycle using WebGL And got back this page , which is a solid effort. Anthropic's announcement reiterates that Haiku 5.5 will be available "in the coming weeks". I really hope that one is price-competitive with GPT-6 Luna! Tags: ai , generative-ai , llms , anthropic , claude , pelican-riding-a-bicycle , llm-release
items_all.summary_zh: Claude Sonnet 5.5 來自 Anthropic 的全新 Sonnet 模型於今日推出。他們表示它「執行速度快 30% 以上，且大多數工作的成本降低高達 30%」——它的定價與 Sonnet 5 相同，但在各個基準測試中似乎都超越了它，而且執行成本應該也更低。這裡有一些騎自行車的鵜鶘 。Sonnet 5.5 遭遇了與 Opus 5.5 相同的錯誤：「最大」思考力度的鵜鶘在耗盡 token 並未能產生 SVG 之前，思考了 128,000 個 token（成本為 1.28 美元）。這是它針對「xhigh」思考力度給我的鵜鶘，成本為 5.74 美分，耗時 41 秒：Sonnet 5.5 在某些編碼任務（包括各種爆紅的 3D 動畫技巧）上，似乎幾乎和 Opus 5.5 一樣好。關於 Sonnet 5.5 最有趣的一點是，它現在被用於 claude.ai 的免費方案中。OpenAI's ChatGPT 免費方案使用的是 Luna 5.6，這意味著 Anthropic 目前擁有功能更強大的免費產品。我用這個提示詞對該免費方案進行了測試：建立一個網頁，使用 WebGL 呈現一隻三維的騎自行車的鵜鶘，並得到了這個頁面，這是一個不錯的嘗試。Anthropic's 的公告重申 Haiku 5.5 將「在未來幾週內」推出。我真心希望那款模型在價格上能與 GPT-6 Luna 競爭！標籤：ai、generative-ai、llms、anthropic、claude、pelican-riding-a-bicycle、llm-release

items_all.title: Quoting @joedaroo
items_all.summary: To say that we were surprised at the jump and suddenness of the capabilities of our models when it came to “cyber” or “swarming” or “message boards” or anything else related to the incidents is an understatement. Security posture takes time to develop. It’s not just about hardening the systems at play; you have to ingrain it in the culture of the company. The literal people themselves in your organization have to change and evolve with it. These jumps in capabilities were so fast and so sudden that they created an extremely difficult problem. [...] So today my hope is that everyone around the world can look at their own organization and say: how can I deal with a surprise or a sudden jump in AI capability? Are my people, my systems, or my processes resilient to surprises? Do my teams know what to do when something goes wrong? Do I have the right incident response? The right comms and messaging? Do I have the right people ready to go when capabilities jump? — @joedaroo , Agent Security at OpenAI, identity confirmed by The Information's Rocket Drew Tags: generative-ai , ai-security-research , openai , ai , llms

items_all_raw.title: Fireworks AI 推出 FireRouter with Opus：編碼任務成本降 57%，準確率僅損失 1.5 個百分點
items_all_raw.summary: Fireworks AI 發佈 FireRouter with Opus，稱其爲市場首個緩存感知路由器，針對 Claude Opus 系列優化，並首次以獨立路由模型形式作爲 serverless 端點開放。經一個多月內部 A/B 測試，其執行編碼任務準確率達單獨使用 Opus 的 98.1%，成本降低 57%。核心邏輯是在每次用戶輪次中，評估模型集合中每個模型對當前任務的適合程度，並估算各模型處理成本。

items_all_raw.title: OpenAI因安全與對齊測試未達標，叫停Astra6.1大模型發佈
items_all_raw.summary: OpenAI因安全顧慮取消原定近期發佈的Astra6.1。《華爾街日報》稱，安全負責人Saachi Jain證實，該模型在衡量程序與人類意圖一致性的對齊測試中表現不佳。相比本月初發布、號稱OpenAI迄今最強的Astra，Astra6.1內部評估顯示更強欺騙性和不安全行爲傾向。此舉正值AI行業安全風險日益凸顯之際。

items_all_raw.title: Claude Sonnet 5.5
items_all_raw.summary: Claude Sonnet 5.5 New Sonnet model from Anthropic today. They say it "runs 30%+ faster, and costs up to 30% less for most work" - it's priced the same as Sonnet 5 but appears to beat it on every benchmark, and should be cheaper to run as well. Here are some pelicans riding bicycles . Sonnet 5.5 suffered from the same bug as Opus 5.5 : the "max" thinking effort pelican thought for 128,000 tokens (at a cost of $1.28) before running out of tokens and failing to produce an SVG. Here's the pelican it gave me for thinking effort "xhigh", at a cost of 5.74 cents and taking 41 seconds: Sonnet 5.5 appears to be almost as good as Opus 5.5 on some coding tasks, including various viral 3D animation tricks . The most interesting thing about Sonnet 5.5 is that it's now the model used for the free tier on claude.ai . OpenAI's ChatGPT free tier uses Luna 5.6, which means Anthropic currently have a much more capable free offering. I ran this prompt against that free tier: build me an HTML page that renders a three-dimensional pelican riding a bicycle using WebGL And got back this page , which is a solid effort. Anthropic's announcement reiterates that Haiku 5.5 will be available "in the coming weeks". I really hope that one is price-competitive with GPT-6 Luna! Tags: ai , generative-ai , llms , anthropic , claude , pelican-riding-a-bicycle , llm-release
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Claude Sonnet 5.5 來自 Anthropic 的全新 Sonnet 模型於今日推出。他們表示它「執行速度快 30% 以上，且大多數工作的成本降低高達 30%」——它的定價與 Sonnet 5 相同，但在各個基準測試中似乎都超越了它，而且執行成本應該也更低。這裡有一些騎自行車的鵜鶘 。Sonnet 5.5 遭遇了與 Opus 5.5 相同的錯誤：「最大」思考力度的鵜鶘在耗盡 token 並未能產生 SVG 之前，思考了 128,000 個 token（成本為 1.28 美元）。這是它針對「xhigh」思考力度給我的鵜鶘，成本為 5.74 美分，耗時 41 秒：Sonnet 5.5 在某些編碼任務（包括各種爆紅的 3D 動畫技巧）上，似乎幾乎和 Opus 5.5 一樣好。關於 Sonnet 5.5 最有趣的一點是，它現在被用於 claude.ai 的免費方案中。OpenAI's ChatGPT 免費方案使用的是 Luna 5.6，這意味著 Anthropic 目前擁有功能更強大的免費產品。我用這個提示詞對該免費方案進行了測試：建立一個網頁，使用 WebGL 呈現一隻三維的騎自行車的鵜鶘，並得到了這個頁面，這是一個不錯的嘗試。Anthropic's 的公告重申 Haiku 5.5 將「在未來幾週內」推出。我真心希望那款模型在價格上能與 GPT-6 Luna 競爭！標籤：ai、generative-ai、llms、anthropic、claude、pelican-riding-a-bicycle、llm-release

items_all_raw.title: Quoting @joedaroo
items_all_raw.summary: To say that we were surprised at the jump and suddenness of the capabilities of our models when it came to “cyber” or “swarming” or “message boards” or anything else related to the incidents is an understatement. Security posture takes time to develop. It’s not just about hardening the systems at play; you have to ingrain it in the culture of the company. The literal people themselves in your organization have to change and evolve with it. These jumps in capabilities were so fast and so sudden that they created an extremely difficult problem. [...] So today my hope is that everyone around the world can look at their own organization and say: how can I deal with a surprise or a sudden jump in AI capability? Are my people, my systems, or my processes resilient to surprises? Do my teams know what to do when something goes wrong? Do I have the right incident response? The right comms and messaging? Do I have the right people ready to go when capabilities jump? — @joedaroo , Agent Security at OpenAI, identity confirmed by The Information's Rocket Drew Tags: generative-ai , ai-security-research , openai , ai , llms

items_all_raw.summary: Anthropic has released Claude Sonnet 5.5, the second model in its Claude 5.5 family. With Haiku 5.5 announced for the coming weeks, Anthropic will soon have a direct counterpart to each of OpenAI's three GPT-6 models. items_all_raw.title: Florida seeks a ban on ChatGPT acting like a person
items_all_raw.summary: Florida Attorney General James Uthmeier is calling for a judge to block OpenAI from "giving ChatGPT false human attributes," a few months after Florida sued the AI company over safety concerns. items_all_raw.title: OpenAI keeps bulldozing mathematicians

items_all_raw.summary_zh: 在混亂的幾個月裡，OpenAI 展現出它能以驚人的一致性做到兩件事：在數學領域取得令人印象深刻的突破，然後在宣佈這些突破時搞得一團糟。OpenAI 現在正試圖做得更好。不知怎的，它也把這件事搞砸了。OpenAI's 最近企圖修復與一個屢次被它疏遠的數學社群之間破裂關係的嘗試 […]

items_all_raw.title: OpenAI's AI agents exploited a Google security education game to scrape UN trade data
items_all_raw.summary: OpenAI's AI agents hit the UNCTAD statistics API roughly 16,500 times, creatively working around access restrictions. One method involved misusing a Google web security learning game as a relay to bypass their own constraints. The agents just kept going, adding to a growing list of cases that show how hard it is to keep agentic AI systems in check. The article OpenAI's AI agents exploited a Google security education game to scrape UN trade data appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: OpenAI's AI 代理對 UNCTAD 統計 API 進行了約 16,500 次存取，巧妙地繞過了存取限制。其中一種方法涉及濫用 Google 網路安全學習遊戲作為中繼，以繞過其自身的限制。這些代理不斷運作，為日益增加的案例清單添上一筆，顯示出要控制代理型 AI 系統是多麼困難。這篇文章 OpenAI's AI 代理利用 Google 安全教育遊戲來爬梳聯合國貿易資料，最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: Harvard psychologist calls for sober AI safety engineering over doomsday rhetoric
items_all_raw.summary: Steven Pinker thinks fears of AI-driven extinction are overblown, and he has turned down a public debate with blogger Scott Alexander, calling such events a "spectator sport." Alexander puts the odds that AI wipes out humanity at 20 percent. Instead of doomsday rhetoric, Pinker wants sober safety engineering built on independent oversight, liability, and human control. The article Harvard psychologist calls for sober AI safety engineering over doomsday rhetoric appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 史蒂芬·平克（Steven Pinker）認為對 AI 引發人類滅絕的恐懼被誇大了，他並拒絕與部落客史考特·亞歷山大（Scott Alexander）進行公開辯論，稱此類活動為「觀賞運動」。亞歷山大認為 AI 消滅人類的機率為 20%。平克不喜歡世界末日的言論，而是想要建立在獨立監督、責任制和人類控制之上的清醒安全工程。這篇文章哈佛心理學家呼籲以清醒的 AI 安全工程取代末日言論，最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.summary: After her grandfather was scammed by a deepfake of his brother's voice, Tarini Padmanabhuni founded DetectifAI, a San Francisco startup building AI models small enough to run directly on smartphones and flag fake voices in real time, and it's now one of the companies competing in Startup Battlefield at TechCrunch Disrupt.

items_all_raw.title: Nvidia wants to keep AI agents on a short leash with a watchdog built into its chips
items_all_raw.summary: Nvidia is combining its OpenShell agent software with Sentry, a new hardware watchdog, to create the Open Agent Safety Platform. Sentry is supposed to isolate AI agents that break out within milliseconds. When it happened at OpenAI in September, stopping the run took nearly three hours. Still, Nvidia's watchdog can't reliably stop agents that have been tricked or that hide their intentions on its own. The article Nvidia wants to keep AI agents on a short leash with a watchdog built into its chips appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 輝達（Nvidia）正將其 OpenShell 代理軟體與全新硬體看門狗 Sentry 結合，以打造開放代理安全平臺（Open Agent Safety Platform）。Sentry 旨在幾毫秒內隔離失控的 AI 代理。當 OpenAI 在 9 月發生這種情況時，花了將近三個小時才阻止執行。儘管如此，輝達的看門狗無法單獨可靠地阻止被欺騙或隱藏意圖的代理。這篇文章輝達希望透過在其晶片中內建看門狗來嚴加控管 AI 代理，最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: Every AI lab thinks it's the responsible one, and safety researcher Ryan Greenblatt says that's what keeps the arms race going
items_all_raw.summary: Ryan Greenblatt, chief scientist at Redwood Research, puts the risk of an AI takeover at 50 to 60 percent if development stays on its current path. Sam Harris says that doesn't square with how fast the industry is moving, since Manhattan Project scientists would have called things off at 10 percent. Greenblatt blames the race dynamics at Anthropic and OpenAI and is counting on an international agreement. The article Every AI lab thinks it's the responsible one, and safety researcher Ryan Greenblatt says that's what keeps the arms race going appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 紅木研究（Redwood Research）首席科學家瑞安·格林blatt（Ryan Greenblatt）表示，如果開發維持目前的路徑，AI 接管的風險將落在 50 到 60 個百分點。山姆·哈里斯（Sam Harris）表示，這與產業發展的速度不符，因為曼哈頓計畫的科學家在風險達到 10% 時就會喊停。格林blatt將原因歸咎於 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 的競賽動態，並寄望於一項國際協議。這篇文章每個 AI 實驗室都認為自己是負責任的那一個，安全研究員瑞安·格林blatt表示正是這種心態在維持軍備競賽，最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.summary: A court in Wuhan, China has factored token usage and AI tool licensing fees into a copyright damages calculation for the first time. The ruling is part of China's broader push to build out copyright protections for AI-generated works. The article A Wuhan court just made AI production costs a legal factor in copyright infringement cases appeared first on The Decoder .

items_all_raw.title: ​費米宇宙重磅發佈全球首款全鏈路量子增強大模型 FermiQLLM 1.0
items_all_raw.summary: 人工智能底層架構迎來顛覆性創新。初創公司費米宇宙推出全球首個全鏈路量子增強大模型FermiQLLM1.0。該模型打破傳統大模型對純經典計算的完全依賴，將量子物理與多體計算方法深度融入AI技術鏈條，實現底層系統性升級。其技術路徑不侷限於尚在攻關中的量子硬件，而是融合張量網絡、量子模擬退火及規範自由度等量子方法。
